body:
Appeal

Name: SpecOpsKip

Reason: Excessive Infractions

Why I should be unbanned: I was not currently online during my ban, and i do not understand why i got excessive infractions then, instead of 2 days earlier when my last warning was. My infractions page can back this up. Also, earlier in the day, when i had last played. Me and MidnightBeats (Also the moderator who banned me) were playing on the same server and were chatting, and i did nothing nor say anything rude, against the rules or anything that you could be kicked for.
